name: Awei T90 2 in 1 ENC Wireless Bluetooth Earbuds With Mic Noise Reduction Headphones ( 6-Month Official Warranty )
description:
Awei T90 2-in-1 ENC Wireless Bluetooth Earbuds with Mic | Noise Reduction | Bluetooth 5.3

Enjoy seamless connectivity, powerful sound, and crystal-clear calls with the Awei T90 ENC Wireless Earbuds. Designed for music, gaming, and all-day comfort, these earbuds combine style with advanced features.

🔑 Key Features

Bluetooth 5.3 & Low Delay (0.06s): Experience stable, ultra-low-latency audio for gaming and streaming.

ENC Call Noise Reduction: Intelligent voice pickup ensures crystal-clear calls, even in noisy environments.

20 Hours Total Battery Life: Up to 7 hours of single-use playback, with an additional 13 hours via the charging case.

Dual-Mode Ear Design: Switch between earcap and earless modes for a custom fit and versatile comfort.

High-Fidelity Sound Quality: 10mm composite diaphragm dynamic driver delivers deep bass, clear mids, and crisp highs.

Multi-Sound Effects (Enco Live): Enjoy personalized listening with multiple sound profiles.

Ergonomic Mini Design: Smooth curved edges, lightweight, and pocket-friendly with a secure grip.

Smart Compatibility: Works seamlessly with smartphones, tablets, laptops, and more.

📦 Package Includes

1 × Awei T90 Earbuds

1 × Charging Case

1 × USB Charging Cable

1 × User Manual
